v0.0.1.description:
The first Alpha release of the archipelago implementation. This should be considered an unstable Alpha and not to be brought to public syncs yet. Please send any bug report either through the issues tab or directly on the Archipelago Discord server in the thread for Paradise Killer. 

The packages used for this release are:
- [RE-UE4SS](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS) V3.0.1
- [lua-apclientpp](https://github.com/black-sliver/lua-apclientpp) V0.6.4
